summary: Revised implementation plan incorporating all 10 additional architectural requirements: Planned-Day vs. Actual-Date Activity progress tracking, Optimistic Concurrency Control (expected_version / 409 Conflict) for daily reflections, normalized Task Status model (Not Started / In Progress / Completed + derived Overdue + audited Rescheduled flag), Draft/Submitted/Edited-After-Submission immutable snapshots, Date-wise pyq_sessions table with audited corrections and chapter aggregation, active vs. archived task denominator rules, and versioned sprint/chapter/task baseline schedules.
